metadata.title: MIMIC decision graph — four patients, 12 tables
metadata.values: Original CSV strings, including blanks and leading zeros; one node per source row.
metadata.names: Display text from source fields; Diagnosis/Procedure use linked code descriptions; LabEvent uses its LabItem label.
metadata.joins: Exact nonempty keys only; blank_key_rows counts child rows left unlinked because a key is blank. _admission_id_mismatch=true records a disagreement between nonempty endpoint admission IDs.
metadata.join_id_convention: J numbers follow the original 31-table join design, so gaps are expected; a join has a separate typed declaration for each child table.
